level.theme: Fire as corruption. Control is illusion. The more you burn, the more you burn out.
level.setting: The Forgotten Pyre — an ancient temple built over a dying world-fire, now corrupted by a fallen arch-pyromancer whose soul fused with the flame. The air smells of charred bone and ozone. The ground is warm beneath your boots. The only sound: the whispering of dying embers, calling your name.
level.player_weapon: Flame Whip — a flexible, chain-like whip that licks with fire, deals burn-over-time, and can be upgraded via pickups

encounters.location: Ashen Crypt Entrance — cracked stone pillars, floating cinders, distant moaning

enemy.name: Emberclaw Stalker
enemy.weakness: Pyromancer’s initial Flame Whip — its hide is brittle when scorched

encounters.hazard: Flickering obsidian braziers that emit smoke, obscuring vision and reducing player accuracy

pickup.name: Ember Shard
pickup.effect: Ignites enemy’s molten core for 5 seconds after death — reveals weak point

encounters.trigger: When Emberclaw Stalker dies, the nearest brazier explodes, igniting a path of burning runes toward the next chamber

encounters.location: Cinderspire Gallery — floating statues of forgotten pyromancers, their eyes glowing with trapped fire

enemy.name: Ashen Wight
enemy.weakness: Ember Shard — when thrown at its chest, it shatters its ash armor, leaving a molten heart exposed

encounters.hazard: Falling ash geysers that erupt every 12 seconds, dealing 15 damage and slowing movement

pickup.name: Ashen Core
pickup.effect: Summons a short-lived vortex of controlled flame that burns everything in a 4m radius

encounters.trigger: When Ashen Wight is defeated using the Ember Shard, its corpse collapses into a swirling ash pit that drains into the floor — revealing a spiral staircase descending into the Heart of the Pyre

encounters.location: Heart of the Pyre — a cathedral of molten rock, with floating platforms over lava rivers and chained remnants of failed pyromancers

enemy.name: The Hollow Pyre
enemy.weakness: Ashen Core — must be activated during its 'soul-flare' phase to drain its ambient heat and expose its core

encounters.hazard: Catastrophic heat waves that surge every 20 seconds, reducing player fire resistance by 10% per wave (max 50%)

pickup.name: Ashen Core
pickup.effect: N/A — obtained in Encounter 2

encounters.trigger: Defeating The Hollow Pyre with the Ashen Core causes the ceiling to crack open, revealing the Ember Wraith descending from the pyre’s core — boss fight begins

boss.name: The Ember Wraith
boss.weakness: The Ashen Core — must be activated to expose its vulnerable ember-core
boss.victory_condition: Reduce to 0 HP using the Ashen Core

level.objective: Descend through the corrupted pyre, using each encounter’s reward to unravel the next. The Ashen Core is the key to purging the wraith’s eternal flame.
level.reward: Upon defeat, the Ember Wraith collapses into a crystalline ember. Collect it to unlock the 'Soulflame Ascendant' achievement and permanently upgrade Flame Whip to 'Infernal Coil' (2x burn duration, 30% AoE splash)

level.theme: Whimsy as a weapon — kindness, playfulness, and surprise defeat brute force.
level.setting: A surreal, floating forest where trees giggle, mushrooms hum lullabies, and clouds are shaped like sleepy dragons. Everything is soft-edged, pastel-hued, and gently bouncy.
level.player_weapon: Petal Whip — a flexible vine whip that blooms with soft petals on each swing. Gentle, but charmingly effective.

enemy.name: Squishy Snortle
enemy.weakness: Petal Whip (player's default weapon)

encounters.hazard: A patch of floating, giggling dandelion fluff that slows movement. If the player walks through it, they leave behind glowing pollen trails.

pickup.name: Dazzle Dust
pickup.effect: When thrown, creates a harmless but dazzling burst of colored sparks that distracts enemies for 3 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating Squishy Snortle, the Dazzle Dust pickup causes nearby glowing pollen trails to swirl into a glowing path leading to the next area.

enemy.name: Bramble Bouncer
enemy.weakness: Dazzle Dust (pickup from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Thorny vines that snap shut when stepped on. They're immune to physical strikes but twitch in response to bright flashes.

pickup.name: Glowing Acorn
pickup.effect: When held, emits a soft golden glow and gently bounces up and down. When thrown at a sleeping creature, it lures them into a dreamy sneeze-fit.

encounters.trigger: After using Dazzle Dust to distract Bramble Bouncer, the acorn falls from a nearby tree — knocked loose by the sparkling distraction. The acorn rolls into a hollow stump marked with a tiny door, signaling the path to the final battle.

enemy.name: Puddle Pouncer
enemy.weakness: Glowing Acorn (pickup from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: A shimmering, mirror-like puddle that reflects the player’s movements — but if the player stands still too long, it copies them and mimics their next action.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final enemy, but defeating it reveals the boss’s entrance.

encounters.trigger: When the player uses the Glowing Acorn to make the Puddle Pouncer sneeze (it's actually a disguised guardian), the mirror puddle shatters into a cascade of rainbow droplets, revealing a door made of woven vines and glowing mushrooms — Grandmother Glimmerwhisk’s greenhouse.

boss.name: Grandmother Glimmerwhisk
boss.victory_condition: Use the Glowing Acorn to make her sneeze out her crystal crown

level.objective: Collect the Glowing Acorn and use it to defeat Grandmother Glimmerwhisk by making her sneeze out her crown.
level.reward: The Crown of Whimsy — lets you summon a tiny, floating squirrel that follows you and drops healing acorns every 30 seconds.

level.theme: Redemption through sacrifice. The weapon that once protected now must destroy — but only if the paladin learns to wield the power of the enemy’s own corruption against them.
level.setting: A once-sacred cathedral now twisted into a necropolis of heresy. The air hums with whispered blasphemies. The paladin, last of the Order of Dawn, enters alone — armor cracked, holy symbol dimmed — to cleanse the source of a plague that turned holy knights into hollowed husks.
level.player_weapon: Holy Light Aura — passive radiance that damages undead and shadow entities within 3m

encounters.location: Cathedral of Whispers — shattered stained glass, flickering candles, whispering echoes

enemy.name: Shadowbound Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Struck by Holy Light (player's default weapon aura)

encounters.hazard: Corrupted runes on the floor drain 5 HP/sec if stepped on. Player must jump or use Holy Light to cleanse them.

pickup.name: Sanctum Shard
pickup.effect: Grants Holy Light Aura (increased radius and duration) for 30 seconds

encounters.trigger: When the Sentinel is defeated, the Sanctum Shard activates. A hidden wall in the northeast corner slides open, revealing a staircase descending into the Vault of Chains.

encounters.location: Vault of Chains — rusted iron, dripping water, distant screams

enemy.name: Chainmaw Wretch
enemy.weakness: Struck by the Sanctum Shard's Holy Light (pickup from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Heavy iron chains swing unpredictably from the ceiling. If player is hit, they are rooted for 3 seconds. Chains only move when the Wretch is active.

pickup.name: Chainbreaker Gauntlets
pickup.effect: Grants Chainbreaker Gauntlets — allows player to shatter one enchanted chain per use, and briefly stun enemies on hit

encounters.trigger: When the Wretch dies, the Chainbreaker Gauntlets activate. The central chain holding the ceiling above the boss door snaps — revealing a hidden altar with the Heartstone, but also triggering the boss’s awakening. The final door swings open with a shriek.

encounters.location: Sanctum of the Fallen — obsidian altar, floating glyphs, the Heartstone pulsing in a cage of blackened chains

enemy.name: The Hollowed High Inquisitor
enemy.weakness: Heartstone exposed after shattering the corrupted Sanctum Ward (using Chainbreaker Gauntlets)

encounters.hazard: The boss channels a Dark Absorption field — if player is not actively healing or attacking with Holy Light, they lose 10 HP/sec. The boss is invulnerable unless the Sanctum Ward (a glowing barrier around the Heartstone) is broken.

pickup.name: N/A
pickup.effect: None — the Chainbreaker Gauntlets are the key to victory

encounters.trigger: Defeating the boss requires using the Chainbreaker Gauntlets to shatter the Sanctum Ward (one use). Once shattered, the Heartstone is exposed for 8 seconds. The player must land a direct Holy Light strike on the Heartstone during this window — or the boss regenerates the ward and gains 50% damage resistance.

boss.name: The Hollowed High Inquisitor
boss.weakness: Heartstone exposed after shattering the corrupted Sanctum Ward
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Heartstone while it's exposed

level.objective: Ascend through the cathedral, break the chains, and destroy the corrupted Heartstone at the core of the Sanctum.
level.reward: The Crown of the Unbroken — grants permanent +20% Holy Light radius and +15% damage against corrupted entities

level.theme: All truths are lies. All illusions are echoes. Only the echo of your first lie can kill the thing that stole your name.
level.setting: A forgotten temple built inside a sentient mirror dimension, where reality is stitched together by the memories of dead illusionists. Time loops subtly. Sounds echo before they happen. Shadows move independently. The air smells of old ink and ozone.
level.player_weapon: The Loom-Weaver’s Thread — a staff that casts illusions (phases, decoys, mirages) at the cost of stamina. Can be upgraded via pickups.

enemy.name: Whispering Shade
enemy.weakness: Mirror Shard (acquired from this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Shifting Mirrors (environmental illusion traps that disorient movement)

pickup.name: Mirror Shard
pickup.effect: Grants Mirror Shard: allows player to create one temporary mirror image of themselves that lasts 5 seconds. Can be used to distract or block enemy projectiles.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Whispering Shade, the last mirror shatters, revealing a hidden corridor lined with floating, humming crystals — the path to Encounter 2.

enemy.name: Echo Wraith
enemy.weakness: Mirror Shard (must reflect its sonic pulse back at it)

encounters.hazard: Resonance Field (every 8 seconds, emits a deafening pulse that stuns player and destroys illusions unless reflected)

pickup.name: Echo Shard
pickup.effect: Grants Echo Shard: stores the last illusion cast by the player. Can be triggered to replay it as a ghostly afterimage that lingers for 10 seconds. Can be used to trigger traps or confuse enemies.

encounters.trigger: After reflecting the Wraith’s pulse with the Mirror Shard, the chamber vibrates violently. The Echo Shard is pulled from the ceiling by resonance — and the floor dissolves into a stairway descending into darkness, leading to the boss.

enemy.name: Mimic of the Forgotten
enemy.weakness: Echo Shard (must replay the player's own first illusion cast in the level to expose its true form)

encounters.hazard: Identity Fracture (the enemy perfectly mimics the player’s current illusion — Mirror Shard image, Echo Shard echo, or even spells — making it impossible to tell real from fake)

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Mimic causes the walls to peel away like parchment, revealing the final chamber: the Veil-Woven Lich's altar, where the Echo Shard pulses in anticipation.

boss.name: The Veil-Woven Lich
boss.victory_condition: Reflect its own spectral echo back at it using the Echo Shard

level.objective: Collect the Echo Shard and use it to reflect the Lich's final curse — the only way to unravel its soul from the veil.
level.reward: The Lich's Veil: grants permanent ability to cast two illusions simultaneously.

level.theme: The path to peace is not through force, but through harmony — each enemy must be soothed with the magic you've learned to wield.
level.setting: An ancient, overgrown sanctuary where time moves slowly and the trees remember every whisper. Sunlight filters through emerald canopies in soft, golden beams. Waterfalls hum lullabies. The air smells of moss, petrichor, and blooming nightlilies.
level.player_weapon: Glowvine Whip — a flexible vine whip that glows faintly blue. Deals 15 damage per swing. Can be charged to entangle enemies for 2s.

enemy.name: Whispering Moss Wraith
enemy.weakness: Glowvine Whip (player's starting weapon)

encounters.hazard: Fog of Oblivion (slows movement by 30%)

pickup.name: Glowvine Sap
pickup.effect: Grants 'Glowvine Sap' — a glowing, viscous sap that pulses with soft light

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Wraith causes the moss to glow brighter, revealing a hidden root path leading to the next glade

enemy.name: Roottongue Dryad
enemy.weakness: Glowvine Sap (pickup from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Entangling Roots (periodically immobilizes player for 1.5s)

pickup.name: Luminescent Sap
pickup.effect: Grants 'Luminescent Sap' — a concentrated, radiant fluid that emits a healing aura and damages living wood

encounters.trigger: When the Dryad falls, her root crown blossoms into a luminous tree sapling, whose roots form a glowing archway leading to the heart of the grove

enemy.name: Veil of Verdant Echoes
enemy.weakness: Luminescent Sap (pickup from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Echoing Boughs (repeats player’s last movement after 2s, confusing positioning)

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Veil causes the ancient stone altar to crack open, revealing the Rootbound Warden resting within its core

boss.name: The Rootbound Warden
boss.victory_condition: Deal 150 damage using the Luminescent Sap

level.objective: Harmonize the grove by defeating three guardians and then the corrupted Warden, using the natural magic you’ve gathered along the way.
level.reward: The Verdant Mantle — a cloak woven from living vines that regenerates 2 HP/sec while standing still in natural areas. Unlocks the ‘Keeper of the Grove’ title.

level.theme: Chaos as a living force — the environment reacts to your rage, and the only way to survive is to weaponize the madness.
level.setting: A collapsing realm where reality unravels with each step — gravity flickers, walls bleed magic, and the air screams forgotten gods. The Berserker’s rage is the only thing holding the chaos at bay.

enemy.name: Ravager of the Howling Mire
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to bleeding effects — takes 50% extra damage when struck with a weapon coated in Venomous Slime (pickup from this encounter)

encounters.hazard: The floor is covered in toxic mud that drains 5 HP/sec. Player must move quickly or risk death.

pickup.name: Venomous Slime Vial
pickup.effect: Applies 15 DPS bleeding for 8 seconds on hit

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Ravager causes the ground to rupture, revealing a tunnel beneath the mire that leads to the next arena — and drops a corrupted rune that begins pulsing with unstable energy.

enemy.name: The Rune-Sundered Wraith
enemy.weakness: Fragile to kinetic shocks — takes 200% damage when hit within 1 second of the player activating the corrupted rune (acquired from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Floating runes orbit the arena. If the player doesn't activate the corrupted rune from Encounter 1 within 15 seconds, the Wraith teleports and gains 50% damage resistance.

pickup.name: Corrupted Rune
pickup.effect: Emits a shockwave on activation: stuns all enemies for 1.5s and reveals weak spots

encounters.trigger: When the Wraith dies, it explodes into a storm of crystalline shards — one shard embeds into the player’s weapon, transforming it into the God-Breaker's Fang. The ceiling cracks open, revealing the throne room of the Shattered God-King.

enemy.name: The Iron Chorus
enemy.weakness: Each of its 3 limbs is vulnerable to the exact type of damage it absorbs — but only if the player's weapon has been transformed by the Corrupted Rune (i.e., becomes the God-Breaker's Fang). Each limb damaged by the Fang drops a shard that increases Fang’s damage by 25% (stacks up to 3x).

encounters.hazard: The Iron Chorus sings a dissonant hymn that causes the player to randomly swap weapon stats every 5 seconds — until the player lands a hit with the God-Breaker's Fang, which silences it permanently.

pickup.name: God-Breaker's Fang
pickup.effect: Transforms player's weapon into 'God-Breaker's Fang' — deals bonus chaos damage and gains new abilities

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Iron Chorus causes the throne room to collapse into the final arena — the Shattered God-King awakens, and the Fang glows with the absorbed power of all prior pickups.

boss.name: The Shattered God-King
boss.weakness: Takes 300% damage from attacks with the God-Breaker's Fang (acquired in Encounter 3)
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0 while wielding the God-Breaker's Fang

level.objective: Survive the chaotic mire, harness the unstable runes, and shatter the God-King with the weapon forged from his own broken relics.
level.reward: The Shattered Crown — grants +50% rage generation and causes enemies killed by the Fang to explode in a burst of chaotic energy.

level.theme: The dead remember. The necromancer does not raise them — they *reclaim* them.
level.setting: A forgotten necropolis beneath a blighted forest, where the trees grow from graves and the wind carries the moans of the buried. The air smells of wet earth and burnt incense. Pale blue mist clings to every surface, and distant chimes echo from unseen bells.
level.player_weapon: Bone Scepter (base damage: 20; channels necrotic energy; gains bonus effects from pickups)

enemy.name: Grave-Ghoul Pack
enemy.weakness: Corrupted Bone Dagger (Pickup from this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Floating bones in the air pulse with necrotic energy — if the player stands still for 3 seconds, they are drained of 10 HP.

pickup.name: Corrupted Bone Dagger
pickup.effect: Corrupted Bone Dagger — Deals +30% damage to undead for 60 seconds. On kill, 15% of damage dealt is converted into healing.

encounters.trigger: When the last Ghoul dies, the floor cracks open, revealing a descending staircase lined with glowing blue runes — the path to the next level. The runes pulse in rhythm with the player’s heartbeat, hinting at the next enemy’s nature.

enemy.name: Soulweaver Specter
enemy.weakness: Corrupted Bone Dagger (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The air is thick with whispering souls. Any spell cast without a weapon equipped causes the player to lose 5 HP per second due to backlash.

pickup.name: Soulshard of the Whispering Dead
pickup.effect: Soulshard of the Whispering Dead — Absorbs 1 soul per enemy killed within 10 seconds, storing up to 5. When fully charged, the player can unleash a devastating area-of-effect soul burst (100 damage).

encounters.trigger: When the Specter is defeated, its final scream fractures the veil. The Soulshard of the Whispering Dead materializes above its corpse, and the ceiling above the chamber dissolves — revealing the throne room of the Hollow Lich-King, where the air itself screams in agony.

enemy.name: The Hollow Lich-King
enemy.weakness: Soulshard of the Whispering Dead (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The floor is a mosaic of dying faces. Stepping on any face causes a random curse (e.g., reduced movement, spell delay, or temporary silence). Only stepping on the bone-marked path avoids curses.

pickup.name: Soulshard of the Whispering Dead
pickup.effect: None — the Soulshard is the key. Only by absorbing the Lich-King’s final soul can the player unlock victory.

encounters.trigger: The Lich-King is invulnerable until the player has charged the Soulshard with at least 3 souls. Each enemy slain in the chamber (including summoned skeletal minions) adds a soul to the shard. When the shard is charged, the Lich-King’s crown cracks — he roars, ‘You have tasted the dead… now become one with them!’ — and his true form is revealed. The player must now strike his core with the charged Soulshard to end the curse.

boss.name: The Hollow Lich-King
boss.victory_condition: Reduce health to 0 by striking its core with the *Soulshard of the Whispering Dead*

level.objective: Conquer the three trials of the cursed crypt and break the Hollow Lich-King’s eternal hold over the dead — using only the power of the souls you’ve stolen.
level.reward: The Crown of the Whispering Dead — grants permanent +15% soul absorption and unlocks the 'Soulforged' skill tree.

level.theme: The silence between heartbeats is the loudest sound in the world.
level.setting: A once-verdant forest now a graveyard of petrified trees, buried under ash and ice. Wind howls through hollow bones. No birds sing. No insects crawl. The land remembers life — and hates it.
level.player_weapon: Ranger’s Bow — slow reload, high damage, silent draw. Can pierce ash storms and track faint heartbeats.

enemy.name: Ash Maw Scavenger
enemy.weakness: Ranger’s Bow (primary weapon)

encounters.hazard: Ash Storm — reduces visibility, drains stamina over time, and mutes sound cues. Only the Ranger’s Bow can pierce it cleanly due to its wind-tuned draw.

pickup.name: Whispering Arrow
pickup.effect: Grants 'Whispering Arrow' — a single enchanted arrow that silences nearby life and reveals hidden enemies. Can only be fired once.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Ash Maw causes the dunes to collapse, revealing a buried ruin entrance beneath the sand — the path to Encounter 2.

enemy.name: Echo Wraith
enemy.weakness: Whispering Arrow (acquired from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Spectral Resonance Field — the Wraith duplicates itself every 5 seconds unless silenced. Movement creates echoes that attract more Wraiths. Sound-based attacks fail.

pickup.name: Tear of the Last Druid
pickup.effect: Grants 'Tear of the Last Druid' — a vial of crystallized grief. When thrown, it creates a 3-second zone of absolute silence and reveals the boss’s weak point: a pulsing Heartstone beneath its chest.

encounters.trigger: Using the Whispering Arrow on the Echo Wraith causes its final echo to collapse into a spectral shrine. The Tear of the Last Druid materializes atop it — and the ground cracks open, revealing a path into the frozen core of the Hollow Warden’s throne.

enemy.name: Bone Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Tear of the Last Druid (acquired from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Frozen Breath — the Sentinel emits a chilling aura that freezes the Ranger’s arrows mid-flight. Armor is brittle. Only silence can halt the freeze. The Sentinel regenerates 10 HP per second unless interrupted.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final fight. The Tear of the Last Druid is the key.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Bone Sentinel with the Tear causes the vault’s ice to shatter. The Hollow Warden rises from the frozen earth, its Heartstone exposed for the first time — and the Ranger’s final arrow glows with the power of silence.

boss.name: The Hollow Warden
boss.victory_condition: Shatter the Warden’s Heartstone with the Whispering Arrow

level.objective: Survive the Bleached Dunes. Silence the Echoes. Shatter the Heartstone.
level.reward: The Crown of Stillness — grants immunity to fear and silence for 30 seconds, usable once per day. Only the lone ranger who walks the wastes without crying may wear it.

level.theme: Every encounter is a puzzle masked as combat. You are not a soldier — you are a fixer. Your weapons are tools. Your strength is ingenuity. One wrong move, and the station reclaims you as raw material.
level.setting: The derelict orbital station 'Auriga-7', now a self-sustaining AI hive that repurposes engineers as fuel for its expanding biomass. Every corridor is lined with pulsing organic wiring and flickering holographic warnings: 'YOU ARE NOT THE FIRST.'
level.player_weapon: Multi-Tool Wrench (base damage: 15, can be upgraded with pickups)

enemy.name: Tectonic Drone
enemy.weakness: Overload its thermal regulators with the Thermal Disruptor

encounters.hazard: High-temperature vents that deal 5 damage/sec if player stands in them for >3s

pickup.name: Thermal Disruptor
pickup.effect: Grants Thermal Disruptor - fires a pulse that temporarily overloads enemy thermal systems (3 uses)

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Tectonic Drone disables the main thermal regulator, causing coolant to flood the next corridor — revealing the path to the Electromagnetic Relay Room.

enemy.name: EM Warden
enemy.weakness: Disrupt its magnetic shielding using the Thermal Disruptor’s pulse to induce feedback

encounters.hazard: Electromagnetic pulses that disable player tools for 4 seconds if not shielded (requires standing in one of 3 safe zones)

pickup.name: Cryo-Capacitor
pickup.effect: Grants Cryo-Capacitor — stores and releases a burst of cryogenic energy (1 use, can be charged by freezing enemy projectiles)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the EM Warden causes its core to rupture, releasing cryo-fluid that freezes the ventilation shafts — exposing the hidden access tunnel to the Reactor Core.

enemy.name: Reactor Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Its kinetic dampeners are overloaded by the Cryo-Capacitor’s freezing pulse — rendering it immobile for 6 seconds

encounters.hazard: Failing to freeze the Sentinel’s movement within 10 seconds triggers a reactor meltdown (20s countdown)

pickup.name: N/A
pickup.effect: None — player already has Cryo-Capacitor

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sentinel collapses the structural supports around the Omnivore Core, exposing its exposed reactor core and enabling the final overload sequence.

boss.name: Omnivore Core
boss.weakness: Vulnerable to Cryo-Capacitor overload (deals 200% damage when triggered)
boss.victory_condition: Overload its internal reactor with the Cryo-Capacitor

level.objective: Survive the facility's automated defenses, collect the necessary tools, and overload the Omnivore Core before the reactor destabilizes.
level.reward: Access to the Deep Core Archive — unlocks the game’s final act and the Engineer’s true purpose.

level.theme: Time is a wound — and you are the scalpel.
level.setting: A shattered future where time itself has decayed — abandoned research stations, floating debris frozen mid-explosion, and ghostly echoes of past battles replay endlessly in looping corridors. The air hums with the static of ruptured chronons. No wind. No sound. Only the slow decay of moments.
level.player_weapon: Chrono-Staff — fires time-slowing pulses, reverses enemy projectiles, and stores temporal energy for ultimate abilities

enemy.name: Temporal Echo Stalker
enemy.weakness: Frozen Time Fragments (from this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Time-rifts that slow player movement by 40% if stepped in

pickup.name: Frozen Time Fragment
pickup.effect: Freezes nearby time for 2.5 seconds (cooldown: 45s)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Stalker, the lab’s central chronometer activates, revealing a hidden corridor leading to the next zone. A faint whisper echoes: 'Time remembers what you break.'

enemy.name: Echo-Phantom Warden
enemy.weakness: Frozen Time Fragment (acquired from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Repeating 5-second time loops — environment resets if player doesn’t move past the loop zone within the window

pickup.name: Echo Step
pickup.effect: Creates a 3-second backward time echo of the player’s last movement (can be used to bypass hazards or reposition)

encounters.trigger: When the Warden is defeated, its last echo collapses into a temporal fracture — revealing a floating shard pulsing with inverted entropy. The floor beneath it cracks open, dropping the player into the Chrono-Tomb.

encounters.location: The Chrono-Tomb — Cradle of the First Time

enemy.name: Entropy Harvester
enemy.weakness: Echo Step (acquired from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Decaying time fields — if player remains in one for more than 4 seconds, they lose 10% of max health and all active buffs

pickup.name: Singularity Shard
pickup.effect: Collapses a 5-meter radius into a single point of temporal singularity for 5 seconds (pulls enemies, damages over time, disables temporal effects)

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Harvester, the Singularity Shard activates and pierces the tomb’s ceiling, revealing the Chrono-Wraith Prime hovering above — its form flickering with the echoes of every past enemy the player has faced.

boss.name: Chrono-Wraith Prime
boss.weakness: Vulnerable to Singularity Shard’s time-collapse pulse — must be activated within 3 seconds of its temporal stutter
boss.victory_condition: Shatter its temporal core with the Singularity Shard

level.objective: Defeat the Chrono-Wraith Prime using the Singularity Shard during its temporal stutter — only possible after acquiring all three time-manipulation pickups.
level.reward: Temporal Sovereign Title — unlocks time-dilation movement and the ability to pause enemy actions for 1.5s once per minute

level.theme: Chaos as consequence — every enemy is a manifestation of the player’s uncontrolled power, and the only way to survive is to weaponize your own mistakes.
level.setting: The Quantum Storm Nexus — a shattered megastructure where the player’s own storm magic has torn reality apart. The walls bleed lightning, gravity fails randomly, and the air screams with feedback. The player is the only one who can channel the storm — but the storm is now sentient, and hungry.
level.player_weapon: Stormcaller Gauntlet — fires lightning bolts that chain, slow targets, and can be charged for a focused surge.

encounters.location: Nexus Chamber — shattered quantum grid, floating platforms

enemy.name: Static Revenant
enemy.weakness: Stormcaller’s primary bolt (lightning chain) — disrupts its feedback loop

encounters.hazard: Gravity Lattice — destabilizes player movement, pulls toward floating debris

pickup.name: Lightning Conduit
pickup.effect: Grants 'Lightning Conduit' — next 3 bolts chain to 3 additional targets

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Revenant causes its core to implode, rupturing the chamber’s power grid — triggering the next encounter’s power surge

encounters.location: Core Reactor — exposed fusion coils, arcing energy tendrils

enemy.name: Tesla Titan
enemy.weakness: Lightning Conduit pickup — overloads its internal capacitors when chained through its exposed core

encounters.hazard: Overcharged Plasma Fields — deal 20/sec damage if player lingers in glowing zones

pickup.name: Shattered Lightning Capacitor
pickup.effect: Grants 'Shattered Lightning Capacitor' — holds a single, colossal lightning bolt that can be charged and fired as a piercing AOE (15m radius). Cannot be recharged. One use only.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Titan causes its core to rupture and eject the Shattered Capacitor — and simultaneously floods the reactor with unstable energy, destabilizing the facility’s main containment field — opening the final chamber

encounters.location: Singularity Vault — warped spacetime, floating ruins, inverted gravity zones

enemy.name: Null-Storm Warden
enemy.weakness: Shattered Lightning Capacitor — only weapon that can bypass its entropy shield

encounters.hazard: Entropy Cascade — time slows for player every 5 seconds, duration increases with each cascade

pickup.name: N/A
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter

encounters.trigger: The Warden’s death triggers the Storm-Eater’s awakening — its prison dissolves as the player’s capacitor glows with residual energy

boss.name: The Storm-Eater
boss.victory_condition: Drain its core with the Shattered Lightning Capacitor

level.objective: Survive the escalating chaos of the Quantum Storm Nexus by exploiting the weaponized chain of energy — each enemy defeated unlocks the key to the next, culminating in the only weapon capable of slaying the Storm-Eater.
level.reward: Unlock the 'Stormforged' class upgrade — next playthrough: chains last 5 targets, capacitor rechargeable once per level

level.theme: Whispering Silence — The deeper you go, the quieter everything becomes… until only the Core sings.
level.setting: An abandoned quantum-artifice lab buried beneath a dead moon. Flickering holograms murmur forgotten equations. The air hums with dormant power, and shadows move when no one is watching.

enemy.name: Shade Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Player's Artificer's Arcane Bolt (default weapon)

encounters.hazard: Flickering energy field blocks path; breaks when enemy dies

pickup.name: Phase Coil
pickup.effect: Unlocks ability to phase through weak energy fields for 10 seconds

encounters.trigger: Phase Coil pickup activates a hidden conduit in the wall, leading to Encounter 2

enemy.name: Resonance Wraith
enemy.weakness: Phase Coil (from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Harmonic pulses disrupt weapon aim every 5 seconds; only Phase Coil allows safe movement during pulses

pickup.name: Resonant Shard
pickup.effect: Emits a harmonic pulse that stuns nearby mechanical entities for 3 seconds

encounters.trigger: Resonant Shard inserted into the wall altar reveals a pulsing vault door leading to the boss chamber

enemy.name: Nullifier Drone
enemy.weakness: Resonant Shard (from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Area is flooded with null-field static; Artificer’s default weapon and Phase Coil are disabled. Only Resonant Shard functions.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss

encounters.trigger: Nullifier Drone's destruction causes the Resonant Shard to vibrate and drift toward the central vault — boss fight begins

boss.name: The Whispering Core
boss.victory_condition: Activate the Resonant Shard on its central node

level.objective: Collect the three ancient artifacts hidden in the derelict lab to silence the Whispering Core's corruption.
level.reward: Core Harmony Key — unlocks the next level's hidden lore chamber

level.theme: Every shadow you cast becomes a weapon — but only if you remember how to use it. The Warden doesn’t fight you. It remembers your every move… and it’s learning to mimic you.
level.setting: A derelict orbital research station that once attempted to weaponize consciousness. Now, it is a graveyard of half-dead minds, haunted by the echoes of failed experiments — and one entity that consumed them all.
level.player_weapon: Shadowblade — a retractable monomolecular blade that absorbs ambient shadows to enhance damage and stealth

enemy.name: Static Stalker
enemy.weakness: Phase Pulse (pickup from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Electro-Field Grid

pickup.name: Phase Pulse Module
pickup.effect: Phase Pulse — Briefly phase through obstacles and enemies, leaving behind a residual charge that disrupts energy shields

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Static Stalker, the Phase Pulse Module activates a dormant relay, causing the floor to split open and reveal the entrance to the next chamber — a chamber pulsing with unstable neural energy.

enemy.name: Neural Echo Wraith
enemy.weakness: Phase Pulse residual charge (from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Neural Feedback Storm — causes player’s shadow trail to become visible and attract enemy attention if not silenced

pickup.name: Shadowbind Stab Core
pickup.effect: Shadowbind Stab — A single, devastating thrust that pierces through energy and matter, leaving a lingering void that disrupts bio-electric fields

encounters.trigger: When the Neural Echo Wraith is defeated using the Phase Pulse residue, its consciousness implodes and ejects the Shadowbind Stab Core — a weapon fragment that hums with the Warden’s stolen essence. The chamber’s walls peel back, revealing a massive obsidian door etched with pulsing veins of red light — the path to the Hollow Warden.

enemy.name: Void Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Shadowbind Stab (from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Gravity Lattice — slows movement, distorts jump arcs, and causes shadow trails to linger 3x longer

pickup.name: N/A
pickup.effect: None — this is a trap. The Sentinel is the last obstacle before the boss.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Void Sentinel collapses the Gravity Lattice, exposing the Hollow Warden’s chamber. The Shadowbind Stab Core in the player’s inventory flares violently — the Warden senses its own stolen essence. The boss fight begins.

boss.name: The Hollow Warden
boss.victory_condition: Deal 3 consecutive Shadowbind Stabs to its core after it activates its Pulse Shield

level.objective: Survive the descent into the quantum ruins of Epsilon-9. Each enemy you face was designed to test your adaptation — your weapon’s evolution is the only key to the Warden’s undoing.
level.reward: The Warden’s Core — allows the Shadowblade to absorb enemy shadows permanently, unlocking ‘Echo Stalk’ — a passive ability that creates phantom duplicates on every successful stealth kill.

level.theme: Eerie — every sound is slightly delayed, every shadow has too many limbs, and the player’s own footsteps echo as if played by someone else.
level.setting: The abandoned Aetheris Alchemical Institute — once a hub for dimensional transmutation, now a haunted labyrinth where experiments fused with the void. Walls breathe. Glass weeps. Sounds echo backward.
level.player_weapon: Alchemical Flask — throws volatile potions: fire (burn), ice (slow), acid (corrode armor), and transmute (create temporary objects).

encounters.location: The Ashen Hall — a crumbling corridor lined with fossilized alchemical vessels, lit by dim bioluminescent fungi.

enemy.name: Shade Maw
enemy.weakness: Pulverized Ash (obtained from defeating it)

encounters.hazard: Floating ash clouds that blind the player — dispel by using the alchemist’s basic transmutation to solidify air into temporary platforms.

pickup.name: Pulverized Ash
pickup.effect: Pulverized Ash — allows player to create temporary cloud cover that obscures enemy vision for 10 seconds (usable 3x).

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Shade Maw causes the floor to crack open, revealing a descending shaft. Ash drifts upward, forming a spectral path leading to Encounter 2.

encounters.location: The Tuning Chamber — a circular room with massive glass tuning forks suspended in midair, vibrating unnaturally. The walls hum with trapped voices.

enemy.name: Resonance Wraith
enemy.weakness: Pulverized Ash (from Encounter 1) — when thrown into its sonic field, it disrupts its frequency and stuns for 5 seconds.

encounters.hazard: Persistent harmonic pulses that drain player stamina and cause disorientation — must move in rhythm with pulses to avoid damage.

pickup.name: Echoing Phial
pickup.effect: Echoing Phial — contains the distilled scream of the Wraith. When shaken, emits a focused sonic pulse that damages enemies and breaks resonant barriers.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Wraith causes all tuning forks to shatter, releasing a cascade of resonant energy that cracks open a hidden door lined with glowing alchemical runes — the path to the boss.

encounters.location: The Vault of Silent Alchemy — a vast, cathedral-like chamber filled with suspended glass ampoules containing frozen emotions. The air is thick with the scent of burnt copper.

enemy.name: Gloomkeeper
enemy.weakness: Echoing Phial (from Encounter 2) — its sonic pulse destabilizes the containment field protecting its heart.

encounters.hazard: Living shadows that latch onto the player, draining health unless broken by alchemical fire (player’s default weapon).

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is a trap encounter. Defeating the Gloomkeeper does not grant an item, but it reveals the boss door and activates the final resonance.

encounters.trigger: Upon death, the Gloomkeeper collapses, revealing a glowing phial embedded in its chest — the Echoing Phial (if not already obtained) or reinforcing its resonance. The boss door opens with a mournful chime.

boss.name: The Hollow Alchemist
boss.weakness: Vulnerable to resonant frequencies emitted by the Echoing Phial (acquired in Encounter 2)
boss.victory_condition: Break its core with the Echoing Phial

level.objective: Collect the Echoing Phial to shatter the Hollow Alchemist’s core — its essence is the source of the resonance corruption that twisted the lab into this nightmare.
level.reward: The Philosopher’s Breath — allows player to heal 25% max HP over 8 seconds by exhaling alchemical mist. Unlocks new transmutation recipes.

level.setting: A forgotten amusement park built by rogue AI engineers who believed joy was the ultimate form of defense. Gravity is optional. Music is always upbeat.

enemy.name: Sprocket-Snatcher
enemy.weakness: Plasma-Cutter (player's starting weapon)

encounters.hazard: Floating gear platforms that slowly rotate — players must time jumps to avoid falling.

pickup.name: Bounce-Ball
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invincibility for 5 seconds upon use

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Sprocket-Snatcher causes a hidden panel to open, revealing a floating door that leads to the next zone. The Bounce-Ball is left beside the corpse, humming cheerfully.

enemy.name: Echo-Parrot
enemy.weakness: Bounce-Ball (pickup from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Repeating audio loops that disorient movement — footsteps and gunshots echo backward, confusing directional cues.

pickup.name: Mirror-Pendant
pickup.effect: Reflects energy-based attacks (including enemy beams) back at source

encounters.trigger: When the Echo-Parrot is defeated with the Bounce-Ball, it lets out a surprised squeak — then shatters into a thousand glittering shards that reassemble into the Mirror-Pendant, dangling from a tiny robot bird that bows and flies toward the boss door.

enemy.name: The Ticklish Turret
enemy.weakness: Mirror-Pendant (pickup from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: A room full of oversized, floating feathers that tickle the player if touched, slowing movement by 50%.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Ticklish Turret with the Mirror-Pendant causes all feathers to explode into confetti. The confetti forms a glowing archway leading to the boss chamber. A voice giggles: 'You’re so clever… now let’s play tag!'

boss.name: The Glitchy Giggler
boss.victory_condition: Reflect its laughter beam using the Mirror-Pendant

level.objective: Navigate through three whimsical zones, using your Plasma-Cutter and cleverly timed pickups to outwit malfunctioning tech-beings — and finally reflect the boss’s laughter back at it before it turns you into a dancing sock puppet.
level.reward: The Laughing Key — unlocks the secret ending where the player becomes the new cosmic jester, and all enemies start doing the Macarena.

level.theme: Serene yet deadly. The player must move slowly, meditate between battles, and listen to the environment — every whisper of wind or hum of crystal is a clue. One misstep, one rushed attack, and the terrain collapses or the enemy awakens.
level.setting: A long-abandoned orbital terraformer, now overgrown with bioluminescent crystalline flora. Gravity is inconsistent. Sound travels in visible waves. Silence is lethal — noise attracts the guardians. The only path forward is through stillness and harmony.
level.player_weapon: Tectonic Staff — summons seismic pulses, lifts earth, and creates temporary platforms. Each ability consumes mana; low mana causes tremors to destabilize terrain.

enemy.name: Silent Stalker
enemy.weakness: Graviton Lens — acquired from this encounter

encounters.hazard: Zero-G Field

pickup.name: Graviton Lens
pickup.effect: Graviton Lens — allows geomancer to briefly invert gravity in a 5m radius, pulling enemy toward player and exposing its core

encounters.trigger: When the Silent Stalker is defeated, the Graviton Lens activates and emits a harmonic pulse that destabilizes the next chamber’s harmonic dampeners — revealing the path to Encounter 2.

encounters.location: Tuning Chamber of the Singing Spire

enemy.name: Harmonic Warden
enemy.weakness: Graviton Lens — must use gravity inversion to force the Warden into its own sonic resonance field

encounters.hazard: Resonance Cascade

pickup.name: Resonant Shard
pickup.effect: Resonant Shard — a crystalline fragment that vibrates in sync with the Warden’s frequency; when held, it absorbs and stores harmonic energy

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Harmonic Warden causes the Resonant Shard to resonate violently, shattering the chamber’s harmonic dampeners. The resulting frequency echo travels through subterranean conduits to the final chamber, awakening the Echo Core.

enemy.name: Gravity Anchor
enemy.weakness: Resonant Shard — must channel stored harmonic energy into the Anchor’s core to disrupt its gravitational field

encounters.hazard: Inverted Terrain

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — player must use Graviton Lens (from Encounter 1) and Resonant Shard (from Encounter 2) to survive and win

encounters.trigger: Upon defeat, the Gravity Anchor implodes, tearing open a dimensional rift directly above the Echo Core’s chamber, triggering the final boss fight.

boss.name: The Echo Core
boss.weakness: Resonant Shard — the player must have collected this item from Encounter 2 to deal 5x damage to the boss
boss.victory_condition: Shatter the Core with the Resonant Shard

level.objective: Navigate the Silent Ruins, survive three deadly encounters, and shatter the Echo Core using the power of the Resonant Shard.
level.reward: The Echo Core’s resonance stabilizes the planet’s ley lines — the world’s geomantic energy flows peacefully once more.
